turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Hannah speaking. How may I help you? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I've just moved house and need to update my address. I'm worried it'll push my premium up, it's already so expensive. My policy number is OS-420999.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Ah, that sounds really frustrating. Let's see what we can do. Thank you, I've got that policy number. Can I take your full name as well, to verify?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Liam OConnor.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, Liam, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you've moved house and need your address updated. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: And what's the new address, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's 22 Maple Close.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can't you just leave my premium the same? It's only a few streets away.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand why that's frustrating, but I'm not able to make an exception, it's a fixed term of the policy. I'm happy to explain how it works if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, we may need to review the details, which can change your price slightly, and any difference is simply worked out for the part of the year that's left.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hold on a second while I check.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 0:43]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks for holding. The change takes effect straight away, your premium may be recalculated, and we'll send your updated policy documents within 3 working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Liam. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've updated your address on the policy.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, Liam. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
